review_notes: The file is about 5,500 lines of one repeated certificate pattern, U_664..U_675, each with 16 component lemmas and a combining lemma. I read the first lemma and the first combiner, then grepped the repeated pattern. I checked the definitions of aρ, bρ, cρ and Uρ, the numeral-evaluation lemmas aρ_k/bρ_k/cρ_k in Table/Common.lean, Uρ_expand and the log_le_* helpers in TableCheck.lean, and their other uses. The only simp-interface issue I found is that the numeral-evaluation lemmas are not simp-tagged, so every call site lists them by hand. I did not run Lean. I did not check whether the proposed attributes change behaviour elsewhere (for example in Table/Tail.lean, which unfolds aρ with `norm_num [aρ, table1]`), nor whether they speed up elaboration. Since the evaluation lemmas are ground equalities with numeral right-hand sides, I do not expect a rewrite loop, but a local scope or named simp set is the safer way to adopt them.

findings.declaration: U_664_1 (pattern repeated in every U_66x_k/U_67x_k lemma and in each U_66x combiner)
findings.excerpt:
(by norm_num [aρ_1, bρ_1])
      (by norm_num [bρ_1]) (by norm_num) (by norm_num [aρ_1, bρ_1]) (by norm_num [aρ_1, bρ_1]) hlg
findings.problem: The equations `aρ k = <rational>`, `bρ k = <rational>` and `cρ k = <rational>` are the canonical evaluations of the opaque table-reading definitions at numerals. They are plain lemmas, not simp lemmas, so each side goal passes them by hand: `norm_num [aρ_k, bρ_k]` four times per component lemma. The combiners also do a manual `rw` through `cρ_1 … cρ_16`. The extra arguments only tell the simplifier how to evaluate `aρ k`, `bρ k` and `cρ k`. Because they are not part of the default simp set, a bare `by norm_num` cannot discharge these goals, and every new certificate has to remember the right index-specific names. The index in each argument also has to match the lemma number by hand, which is easy to get wrong in generated files. The lemmas are ground equalities with numeral right-hand sides, so tagging them should not cause a loop.
findings.proposed_change: In Table/Common.lean, tag `aρ_1 … aρ_16`, `bρ_1 … bρ_16` and `cρ_1 … cρ_16` with `@[simp]`. If tagging them globally is undesirable, use `attribute [local simp] aρ_1 …` or a named simp set in the Table files. The side goals then become `(by norm_num)`, with no per-index argument list. The combiner can use `rw [Uρ_expand]; simp only [cρ_1, …]`, or `norm_num` with the local simp set. Check that Table/Tail.lean, which uses `norm_num [aρ, table1]`, still behaves the same.
findings.benefit: Generated proofs no longer depend on the index-specific lemma names, so a mismatched index cannot slip in. The ~190 repeated argument lists, one per component lemma side goal and one per combiner, shrink to one declaration of the simp set. The evaluation of the table entries has a single canonical normal form.
